messages.content: "假設您正在考慮在加州舊金山購買一棟房子。該房子建於1985年，佔地2000平方英呎，共有4間房間。您想要預測這棟房子的價格。在購買房子後，您還想了解前任屋主John Doe先生在舊金山涉及的任何訴訟。此外，您也想知道在一個可能的結果總數為1000且有5個有利結果的抽獎中獲勝的機率。您希望結果保留3位小數。請問您能提供預測的房價、John Doe先生在舊金山的訴訟情況，以及中獎機率嗎？"

function.description: Calculate the probability of an event. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

round_to.description: Number of decimal places to round the result to.

function.name: predict_house_price
function.description: Predict house price based on area, number of rooms and year of construction. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

area.description: Area of the house in square feet.

rooms.description: Number of rooms in the house.

year.description: Year when the house was constructed.

location.description: The location or city of the house.
